export: rewindagent export --session abc --out replay.html  # a given session, to a given file
rewindagent export --no-contents                    # steps, tools and paths only: no inputs, results or diffs
hook: rewindagent install            # adds the hook to .claude/settings.json in this project
rewindagent install --settings ~/.claude/settings.json   # or for every project
install: pipx install git+https://github.com/Johnbjoseph-cybersec/rewindagent     # or: pip install git+https://...
record: rewindagent verify     # OK: 1 records, chain intact
replay: rewindagent replay              # one line per step: number, tool, file or command
rewindagent replay --step 12    # step 12 in full: input, checkpoints, result
rewindagent rewind 12           # files back to how they were right after step 12
rewindagent branch 12 --name try2   # keep the current files, then rewind to step 12
sessions: rewindagent sessions                     # every session in the log: id, first and last time, steps, files touched
rewindagent sessions --grep config.py    # only sessions with a step that mentions it, and those steps

hero: session demo: rewind to step 12 of 14 (did change 4 files)
this rewind is step 15; undo it with: rewindagent rewind 14 --session demo
promise: Ctrl+Z for AI coding agents: record, replay, rewind.
